Good evening and welcome to our live coverage of the Carabao Cup third-round tie between Ipswich Town and Arsenal. Mikel Arteta’s side have won all six of their matches so far this season, but travel to Portman Road fresh off an incident-filled win over Sunderland which thrust officiating back into the spotlight after Ezri Konsa conceded a penalty having been – in Arteta’s words – “judo-rolled” by Dan Ballard.

In a recent development, after the match, the Arsenal manager mentioned: “I watched [the incident] 20 times and I cannot find a way to understand how to even think to give a penalty in this situation or the way the VAR has to intervene. So I don’t know what to think, really. But I’m sad, that we have to discuss, after such a beautiful game, something at this level that has the gravity of that because that changes the course of the season and it can cost you the championship… This cannot happen.”.

Arteta may be pleased that VAR is not in use at this stage of the Carabao Cup, and all eyes will be on Peter Bankes who takes charge of tonight’s match against Ipswich.

Sources indicate that this season Arsenal hope to arrest a startling League Cup record. It has been 33 years since they last lifted the trophy, during which time they have been runners-up seven times. Losing last year’s final will have also added fuel to Arsenal’s fire, and Arteta may resolve he must field a strong starting XI. In fact, he may not have much choice in his backline as Ben White has emerged as a serious injury doubt after picking up an injury at the Stadium of Light and may join Cristhian Mosquera and William Saliba on the treatment table. This would likely mean starting Jurriën Timber, who is only just returning from a long-term groin problem. There is more scope for rotation in advanced positions, with Noni Madueke, Viktor Gyokeres, Eberechi Eze and Mikel Merino contenders to start.

According to recent reports, A 90th-minute Zian Flemming winner against Crystal Palace on Saturday helped Gary O’Neil’s Ipswich to their second win in four Premier League games, a feat they required 16 matches to achieve the last time they were in the top flight. Heavy investment into Ipswich’s squad has proved fruitful thus far, though in-form striker Emersonn is expected to sit out tonight having taken a knock at Selhurst Park.

PSV Eindhoven endured a frustrating night in the Champions League as their defensive frailties were exposed in a 2-1 defeat by Club Brugge.

PSV started full of attacking intent and should have taken an early lead when Ivan Perisic put Sergiño Dest clean through on goal, but the defender’s shot was too close to goalkeeper Yann Sommer.

Instead it was the visitors who took the lead with their first real attack when Nicolo Tresoldi headed in a teasing cross from Joaquin Seys.

According to recent reports, PSV equalised early in the second half as an outstanding pass by Sven Mijnans into the path Lutsharel Geertruida allowed the defender to charge to the byline. His pullback found its way to Kodai Sano, whose shot took a deflection off Seys into the net.

But five minutes later PSV were caught out as another razor-sharp pass by Seys released Carlos Forbs in space to net the winner.

The home side refused to give up, but were unable to find a way past Sommer in the closing stages as the Belgian side closed out the win.

Team captain Mauro Junior admitted that PSV had been undone by shortcomings at the back. “We had a lot of opportunities in the first half but we didn’t score,” he told Ziggo Sport.

“We want to attack and score goals, but we weren’ well organised today in defence. We need to keep our heads up and look forward to the next game.”.

The result leaves PSV in 24th place, just above the elimination line, ahead of their next match away to Real Madrid on November 24, with four points from their opening four matches.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Comme les U19 il y a une semaine dans le même stade Country 1 basé à Borgo (Haute-Corse), les U17 se sont inclinés par 3 buts d'écart (4-1) face au Sporting Club de Bastia.

Après avoir concédé l'ouverture du score dès la 10e minute de jeu sur une frappe déviée, les Verts ont égalisé à la fin du dernier quart d'heure sur un centre d'Isaak Seydi repris par Naël Dani (photo) d'une frappe croisée. Les Corses ont repris l'avantage une minute avant la mi-temps sur un corner repris de la tête au second poteau par un joueur étrangement seul...

Alors que les Verts ont raté 4 face à face (2 par Naoufan Mnemoi, un par Isaak Seydi et un autre par Maxime Thibaudat), les Bastiais ont fait le break à la 56e minute sur un coup franc direct ayant surpris un Andrea Laugier pas idéalement placé... Ayant corsé l'addition à la 70e minute, Bastia pique la 4e place à l'ASSE, qui devra réagir dimanche prochain à la maison contre le Cavigal.

La compo : Laugier - Tiambo (Balta, 62'), Mnemoi, Dagbo, Bufferne - Demassieux (Diakité, 69'), Gobé, Thibaudat - Dani, Kimpioka, Seydi (Aytone, 69').

In a recent development, la réaction de David Le Moal : "On a singulièrement manqué de rythme en première période et de qualité technique après la mi-temps. On a fait beaucoup de centres mais on était rarement bien placé pour les reprendre. Bastia a été très réaliste offensivement contrairement à nous. Sur nos 4 énormes occasions, des face à face, une fois le gardien a fait une parade mais les 3 autres fois on n'a pas réussi à cadrer. Difficile dans ces conditions d'espérer un résultat positif.".

Mauricio Pochettino should TURN DOWN the Man United job unless he gets TWO latest signings to fix 'the worst back four in the Premier League', says Gary Neville

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Published: 03:19 EST, 12 November 2026 | Updated: 10:08 EST, 12 November 2026.
  • Mauricio Pochettino has been warned against taking the Manchester United job, by Gary Neville unless the club's hierarchy promise to back him in the January transfer window and bolster 'the worst back four in the Premier League'.
  • Sources indicate that as reported by Daily Mail Sport, Pochettino is expected to be named as the fresh Red Devils head coach, replacing Michael Carrick.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By LUKE AUGUSTUS, ASSISTANT SPORTS EDITOR.

Published: 03:19 EST, 12 November 2026 | Updated: 10:08 EST, 12 November 2026.

Mauricio Pochettino has been warned against taking the Manchester United job, by Gary Neville unless the club's hierarchy promise to back him in the January transfer window and bolster 'the worst back four in the Premier League'.

Sources indicate that as reported by Daily Mail Sport, Pochettino is expected to be named as the fresh Red Devils head coach, replacing Michael Carrick. Carrick was pictured arriving at Carrington on Thursday morning before being sacked just hours later.

Recent findings suggest that director of football Jason Wilcox was pictured arriving to the club's training ground on Thursday morning too. He had been in Monaco the day before with the club’s chief executive Omar Berrada, where minority owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe ratified their decision to sack Carrick with the blessing of co-chairmen Joel and Avram Glazer.

United moved closer to putting Pochettino in charge at Old Trafford after reaching a verbal agreement with the US national team boss on Wednesday. The club then made a formal approach to US Soccer.

Upon Pochettino's expected arrival, he will join a club languishing in the relegation zone - with United 18th in the Premier League with just one win from their opening 10 matches.

United have conceded 19 goals across those 10 games - with only 14th-placed Ipswich Town (20) and bottom side Crystal Palace (24) having conceded more.

Mauricio Pochettino (pictured) has been warned against becoming the fresh Manchester United head coach by Gary Neville unless they promise him defensive reinforcements in January.

Michael Carrick arrives at Carrington on Thursday morning ahead of his Man United sacking.

Director of football Jason Wilcox was pictured arriving to the club's training ground on Thursday morning after being in Monaco on Wednesday to discuss Carrick's fate at the club.

And speaking about Pochettino's pending arrival, Neville insists on the Argentine making ultimatums to the board if they want him - starting with improving the defence.

'If I was Mauricio Pochettino now, I would be literally protecting myself up to the high heaven,' he mentioned on The Overlap.

According to recent reports, 'He'll do that with a pay-off. So do that in your contract. But secondly, he needs two defenders in January. So he's got to insist that he gets two defenders in January. He's got to insist that he gets a minimum budget next summer for the transfer we're not to be able to turn this around. He's got to insist that he gets a budget that follows.

'They have to give it to him or else he shouldn't take the job.'.

Expanding further, the former United right back didn't hold back in his criticism of the current defensive options at the club.

'I mean look the back four that he finished with on Sunday was [Diogo] Dalot left back, [Noussair] Mazraoui right back, Leny Yoro and Ayden Heaven,' he remarked.

'That is probably the worst back four in the Premier League. I don't know a back four that is worse than that in the Premier League right now if I watch it. That is I can't believe Manchester United have ended up with that back four.'.

Pochettino is currently at the US Soccer base outside Atlanta preparing for a CONCACAF Nations League quarter-final double header against Haiti, and is due to speak to the media on Friday.

Neville believes Manchester United have 'the worst back four in the Premier League'.

Diogo Dalot (left) gave away a penalty during United's 4-4 draw with Aston Villa on Sunday.

It’s unclear if he will remain in charge for those games, with United said to be relaxed over the Argentine taking the team. It is possible he could stay for the first leg in Kingston, Jamaica at the weekend and then travel to Manchester.

The second leg in Cincinnati is not until the early hours of Thursday, and Pochettino may even would only take over at United on Friday with a huge game against Liverpool at Anfield 48 hours later.

It’s understood that the US Soccer Federation are ready for this contingency and have a succession initiative in place should he leave.

It will cost Pochettino around £7million to buy himself out of his contract with the US Soccer Federation, with United ready to foot the bill.

The cost of bringing in his back-room team, including trusted assistants Jesus Perez and Miguel D’Agostino, will take the cost above £10m.

The 54-year-old only signed a newly introduced deal after the World Cup meaning that United could have got him for nothing in the summer.

Mylan Toty, auteur d'un doublé aujourd'hui.

Vous avez pu suivre la rencontre en live sur le forum grâce à notre envoyé spécial P2 Machupicchu42, les Verts au prix d'une meilleure seconde période sont allés chercher 3 points importants.

In a recent development, malgré le renfort de Mourtada Gueye et Maxime Lengue Lenou, habituellement appelés en réserve, la première demi-heure est compliquée pour les hommes du coach Frédéric Dugand qui en manque de confiance laissent les initiatives à l’adversaire. Logiquement, l’US Cap d’Ail va ouvrir le score à la 21ème minute. Le dernier quart d’heure voit les jeunes Verts plus entreprenants mais il faut attendre la 38ème minute pour voir une première frappe verte. La pause intervient sur ce maigre retard au tableau d’affichage. (ASSE 0 Cap d’Ail 1 ; mi-temps).

Au retour des vestiaires Aboubakar Traoré remplace Maxime Lengue Lenou et ce changement va payer. Les Verts sont plus offensifs et à la 59ème minute, Mylan Toty, sur un service d’Aboubakar Traore vient tromper le portier adverse et égaliser.

Les Verts vont enchainer, avec 3 minutes plus tard, un service de Tidiane Vibert pour Mylan Toty qui permet à ce dernier de doubler la mise. Les Stéphanois mènent au score et malgré une réaction de l’US Cap d’Ail dans les dernières minutes vont conserver leur avantage et remporter une victoire très importante pour le classement et la confiance du groupe. (ASSE 2 Cap d’Ail 1 ; score final).

La semaine prochaine, les Verts (10 points) se déplaceront à Nice pour y affronter le Cavigal (13 points), victorieux ce jour à Balma (1-0).

La Composition : Massé  – Lengi,  E.Mnemoi, Gueye (cap), Jolivet – Vibert (Akil 90ème), N.Mouton, Thouilleux, Lengue (A.Traoré 46ème) - Zibi (Marliac 88ème), Toty.

Recent findings suggest that la réaction de Frédéric Dugand : « Notre équipe était en plein doute, cela s’est vu durant les 30 premières minutes, difficiles. Menés, les joueurs ont réagi et se sont lâchés pour aller chercher la victoire, avec plus de caractère. J’espère que ça va aider pour la suite, pour être plus juste défensivement et dans nos choix de jeu. On doit mieux gérer nos émotions et prendre confiance. Il faut inverser la dynamique, faire plus de courses, provoquer ce changement. C’est à ce prix qu’on ira chercher le maintien ».

PSV returned to the top of the Eredivisie with a thumping 5-2 win over Cambuur Leeuwarden as previous leaders Feyenoord lost a seven-goal thriller against the other Frisian club, Heerenveen.

It took just 46 seconds for PSV to get off the mark as Sven Mijnans headed in unmarked.

The midfielder added a second after 15 minutes and completed his hat-trick with a free-kick in the 80th minute to make the score 4-2, just as Cambuur were threatening a comeback.

Feyenoord’s dip in form continued as they let a two-goal lead slip at Heerenveen. The Rotterdammers looked to be in control going into the break with a trademark drilled shot by Anis Hadj Moussa and a penalty by Nacho Ferri.

But Maas Willemsen bundled in the ball from a corner on the stroke of half-time, before Ringo Meerveld came on for the second half and scored a hat-trick as Feyenoord’s defence crumbled under pressure.

“In the matches when we played well I saw a team that fought for each other,” Feyenoord coach Giovanni van Bronckhorst said after the game. “Mentally strong, kept running even when we didn’t have the ball. That’s our strength. When we don’t do that we’re a lesser team.”.

Mexx Meerdink scored a hotly contested late penalty to settle a tempestuous game in Alkmaar as AZ came back from 3-1 down against Groningen to claim their first win in five matches.

Industry observers note that goalkeeper Etienne Vaessen was given a second yellow card for protesting too hard against the decision to penalise him for upending Ayoub Oufkir. Once the commotion died down Meerdink, who had missed from the spot against Vaessen earlier in the second half, made no mistake against substitute goalkeeper Lovro Stubljar.

Ajax missed the chance to take over top spot at Twente as their former striker Wout Weghorst scored a last-minute penalty to rescue a point for the home side.

Ajax had been 2-0 up with a bullet header by their giant striker Tolu Arokodare and a long-range strike by Rayane Bounida, before an own goal by Dies Janse brought the visitors back into the game.

According to recent reports, fortuna Sittard also had to settle for a point against Telstar after going 2-0 up thanks to a bizarre own goal by Sem Valk. The defender’s sliced clearance looped over the head of Ronald Koeman Junior as the goalkeeper tried to head it away rather than risk being penalised for handling a backpass.

Goals just before half-time by Abdelnour Soualhia and Patrick Brouwer brought Telstar back into the game, but neither side was able to find a winner after the break.

That result allowed ADO, under the guidance of interim coach Levi Schwiebbe, to close the gap on 16th-placed Telstar to one point with a 3-1 win against Sparta, while bottom Willem II collected their third point of the season at home to PEC Zwolle.

ADO Den Haag 3-1 Sparta Rotterdam.

After Alphonso Davies suffered an injury setback while playing for Canada in a game against Guatemala last week, Bayern Munich have now provided an upgrade on the left-back's condition.

As confirmed by the German champions on Monday, examinations carried out by the club's medical team revealed that Davies has suffered a minor muscle tear in his left hamstring.

Bayern added that the 26-year-old is therefore “set for a spell on the sidelines”, without providing a specific timeframe for his recovery.

According to Munich-based outlet TZ, Davies is expected to be sidelined for around 7-10 days, with Bayern hopeful of having him fit in time for next week's Champions League clash against Lille.

#2890. Industry News: Spurs finally score... but still lose

Industry News: Spurs finally score... but still lose

📅 16 Sep 2026 | ⏱️ 25 min read (5028 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~25 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Tottenham Hotspur, the team with more zeroes than an England Ashes batting collapse, found the back of the net but still frustration persists for Roberto De Zerbi.
  • According to recent reports, it could have been something different.
  • “I think this is five or six games we have been for sure not lucky,” De Zerbi lamented, but sympathy did not extend too far.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

They scored. Would you believe it? Tottenham Hotspur, the team with more zeroes than an England Ashes batting collapse, found the back of the net but still frustration persists for Roberto De Zerbi.

According to recent reports, it could have been something different. The sight of the Italian dashing down the touchline in hailstones, grabbing his head in disbelief in the final seconds, showed this was not a straightforward tale of misery but, ultimately, the misery endures.

“I think this is five or six games we have been for sure not lucky,” De Zerbi lamented, but sympathy did not extend too far. Liverpool deservedly moved into the next round of the Carabao Cup, the gloss on Andoni Iraola’s most enjoyable night provided by Dominik Szoboszlai’s goal-of-the-season contender.

According to recent reports, THAT'S MAGNIFICENT! 💥🔴Outrageous strike from Dominik Szoboszlai 👏👏👏 pic.twitter.com/meQ7nilsz6.

Liverpool were abject against Fulham on Saturday but with 10 changes to the starting line-up, infused with the exuberance of novices Rio Ngumoha and the terrific Lewis Koumas, Iraola’s team were invigorated and only a lapse of concentration enabled Tottenham to make a fist of it.

Recent findings suggest that yes, they went down swinging, as their noisy fans demanded. But carelessness cannot be excused and while De Zerbi complained about bad luck, a bad miss from Lucas Bergvall in the 10th minute was the fork in the road for the tie. Tottenham stalled and Liverpool never looked back.

“We have to shoot more times and we have to shoot better,” De Zerbi harrumphed. “We have to finish better the clear situations. We are sorry for the result, disappointed and frustrated. I think it was unfair but we have to be stronger in these unlucky moments.”.

Rather than fizzing his drive into the net, Bergvall succeeded only in firing straight at Giorgi Mamardashvili, when he had the whole target in front of him. It was, in all fairness, a brilliant save but he should never have been allowed to make it.

According to recent reports, major save from Giorgi Mamardashvili! 💪Lucas Bergvall is denied by the Liverpool goalkeeper. pic.twitter.com/fKUbfGLMku.

According to recent reports, the miss changed the atmosphere, as suddenly Liverpool grasped the need to be competitive. At the heart of it all were Ngumoha, James McConnell, Trey Nyoni and Koumas, the last-named a nuisance to Tottenham’s defenders in the way a wasp is to picnickers on a summer’s afternoon.

For all the money that has been lavished by this club over the past 14 months, the one thing that the locals buy into more than anything is the basics done properly: hard work, tackling, a refusal to take second best. Iraola did not want Koumas to go anywhere this summer and it was obvious why.

“I see him training every day,” Iraola noted. “He knows very clearly what he needs to do, what the team needs. And also the energy he shows is contagious for the rest. When you see the runs up front, giving everything, you are kind of forced to go behind and use the same intensity levels.”.

Industry observers note that simple tenacity enabled Liverpool to get back on an even keel and laid the foundation for them to take the lead. It was a terrific goal, started with a raking pass from Joe Gomez that Cody Gakpo controlled instantly on his chest before scuttling inside and inviting Ngumoha to charge forward.

Whether it was the winger or Destiny Udogie, who was sliding to make a challenge, that ended up playing the ball to Alexis Mac Allister is immaterial, all that mattered is that the Argentine effortlessly placed his shot into the top corner, leaving Martin Dubravka planted and helpless.

Pick that out!! 🇦🇷Alexis Mac Allister hits a beauty into the roof of the net 🔴 pic.twitter.com/G7OT27CA8P.

Industry observers note that is Mac Allister playing with a point to prove? Possibly, given his comments about not being offered a upcoming contract last week. Will Iraola be bothered? Not in the slightest. All he wants is top players at the top of their game and Mac Allister is climbing towards the levels he showed two years ago.

What De Zerbi would do to have a player in such form, but Tottenham are a skittish bunch, not the type of team who respond well in the face of adversity and their head coach, dressed in black with his oversized white trainers, regularly shook his head in exasperation.

It has been revealed that his mood was not helped just before the interval, when Mohammed Kudus blasted over from eight yards following a zipped-in cross from Udogie, but he would not have called it truthfully if he had suggested Tottenham deserved parity at that stage. Soon Liverpool’s advantage would be doubled.

The buffer they sought arrived in the 54th minute and, again, it was another genuinely attractive goal, with possession being kept until it sped up when Ngumoha scurried forward, found Milos Kerkez, who played it to Mac Allister, who in turn gave Gakpo the opening he craved.

His touch was excellent, his finish was even better and away in the distance Iraola rattled his fists in delight. That is two goals and four assists to start the campaign for the Dutchman and yet Liverpool were ready to sell him to Manchester City two weeks ago. What on earth were they thinking?

Ruthless!! 🔥Cody Gakpo doubles Liverpool's lead against Spurs 🔴 pic.twitter.com/qlaaynMuwM.

Recent findings suggest that from that point, it seemed inconceivable that Liverpool would finish living on their nerves, but De Zerbi’s decision to introduce Andy Robertson – given a hero’s reception on his first return to Anfield – and Mateus Fernandes wrestled back some impetus. There was also a significant helping hand.

Unsurprisingly, Andy Robertson gets a great reception from the Liverpool fans on his return to Anfield 👏 pic.twitter.com/uNM6A00k5F.

Mamardashvili had made some notable saves, including one from Kudus that he celebrated on his own, but he is vulnerable at set-pieces and Fernandes’s looping corner gave Conor Gallagher the easiest headed opportunity in three years to change the dynamic.

Spurs have scored! ⚪️Conor Gallagher brings Roberto De Zerbi's side back into the game! pic.twitter.com/52zSCqClw4.

“We were under pressure at the end, but I don’t think we were nervous,” Gakpo said.

In a recent development, he was right. Try as they might, Spurs could not quite get the opening they needed and as they chased in vain, Szoboszlai administered the final blow in mesmerising fashion, thrashing a bouncing ball into the Kop net from 30 yards. And as De Zerbi realised in the sodden conditions, with Tottenham it never rains. It only pours.

"A Steven Gerrard type of strike" 😍Jamie Redknapp and Conor Coady analyse Dominik Szoboszlai's wondergoal 🪄 pic.twitter.com/h9QTuP8lZc.

🗣️ "The young players give us energy" 💪Andoni Iraola is very pleased with the way the Liverpool youngsters played after beating Spurs 3-1 at Anfield 👏#ITVFootball | @Carabao_Cup | @markpougatch | @Robbie9Fowler pic.twitter.com/bHjOrmccH2.

🗣️"Szoboszlai scores A LOT OF BANGERS"😂Needless to say Cody Gakpo was really impressed with Dominik Szoboszlai's goal for Liverpool 👏#ITVFootball | @LFC | @Carabao_Cup | @gabrielclarke05 pic.twitter.com/O3bs6Y9M2p.

"They've done themselves proud!" 👏Conor Coady on Lewis Koumas performance for Liverpool 🔥 pic.twitter.com/3JGkuY7Eye.

Sources indicate that andrew Robertson received a great reception from the Anfield crowd whilst warming up, when he came on and now at full-time. He catches up with old teammates as he heads off in the pouring rain, applauding the Liverpool fans.

It has been revealed that there is the final whistle at Anfield and Liverpool book their place in the fourth round of the League Cup courtesy of a 3-1 win over Tottenham. Andoni Iraola’s side scored three stunning goals to seal their progression.

Mamardashvili does well to save from a deflection, like he did a few minutes ago. Mamardashvili did not cover himself in glory for Tottenham’s goal but has made some great saves tonight.

Recent findings suggest that oh my word! The Hungarian loves a screamer and this is another to add to the list. It is similar to a goal Suarez scored at The Kop End against Norwich a number of years ago. Szoboszlai chests it down and from nearly 30 yards out smashes across the ball. The ball flies into to the top corner, always going away from Dubravka, and Szoboszlai celebrates in front of The Kop. A quite incredible goal.

According to recent reports, THAT'S MAGNIFICENT! 💥🔴Outrageous strike from Dominik Szoboszlai 👏👏👏 pic.twitter.com/meQ7nilsz6.

There will be four added minutes at Anfield.

Savio has an effort from the right side of the box but drags his shot wide of the far post.

Liverpool counter with Mamardashvili’s long ball forward for Isak, who gets the better of Gray on the left side of the box. Isak gets his shot away and the ball appeared to hit Tosin’s arm but the penalty is not given. Replays show it did hit Tosin’s arm and he is lucky there is not VAR tonight as that could well have been overturned.

It has been revealed that solanke is on for Tottenham in place of Tel as the visitors have a corner out on the right. Tottenham take it short before the delivery is swung in and headed away by Gakpo as the rain comes thrashing down again at Anfield.

Tottenham keep it alive and Marmoush has an effort from the left side of the box. It deflects off Araujo and Mamardashvili makes a stunning save.

Szoboszlai should bury a guilt-edge chance inside the Tottenham penalty area but his effort is saved. There was a suspicion of offside against Szoboszlai but the flag did not go up. Szoboszlai was being played onside by quite some way by Gray so a huge missed opportunity.

Sources indicate that that is superb one-vs-one defending from Jacquet. The ball is played down the left channel but Jacquet gets the better of Marmoush.

Into the final 10 minutes we go at Anfield.

Liverpool are under pressure at the moment as Tottenham attack the Anfield Road End, where the travelling Spurs supporters are housed. Mamardashvili is again unconvincing when dealing with a corner into the box.

Double change for Tottenham as Savio and Maddison replace Kudus and Gallagher.

Industry observers note that that is a stupid challenge from Kerkez, who is booked for a silly foul on Gallagher. Kerkez was asking for a booking for that challenge and referee Andy Madley obliges.

Change for Liverpool as Barcola replaces Ngumoha.

Recent findings suggest that the visitors take advantage of very poor keeping from Mamardashvili. Fernandes’ delivery should be dealt with by Mamardashvili but the Georgian keeper flaps at empty air. It comes to Gallagher, who has a simple header from just a few yards out. A lifeline for Tottenham, who have their first goal this season against Premier League opposition.

Spurs have scored! ⚪️Conor Gallagher brings Roberto De Zerbi's side back into the game! pic.twitter.com/52zSCqClw4.

Tottenham have had some decent chances tonight. The latest comes for Gallagher just inside the Liverpool box but his effort takes a deflection off Kerkez and goes behind for a corner...

It has been revealed that that is a crucial challenge from Kerkez inside his own box. Marmoush looked like he was going to have a great opportunity from 10 yards out in the centre of Liverpool’s penalty area but Kerkez intervenes with a superbly-timed challenge to deny the Egyptian.

Double change for Liverpool as Szoboszlai and Gravenberch replace Nyoni and McConnell in the centre of Liverpool’s midfield.

Mamardashvili makes an vital save. Marmoush carries the ball a long way down Tottenham’s left before cutting inside. As he gets to the Liverpool box, he plays the ball across to his right to find Kudus, whose first-time effort is saved well by Mamardashvili down to his left.

Robertson is going to come on for Tottenham against his former side and receives a great reception from the Liverpool fans, similarly to the reception Ray Clemence received all those years ago:.

Legendary goalkeeper, Ray Clemence would've turned 78 today ❤️Not many former players get a reception as good as this when they come back to Anfield, he was a true Liverpool great 🙌 pic.twitter.com/NLH3nZUJjd.

Fernandes is also on for the visitors.

Unsurprisingly, Andy Robertson gets a great reception from the Liverpool fans on his return to Anfield 👏 pic.twitter.com/uNM6A00k5F.

Tosin decides to shoot from range but drags his effort wide of Mamardashvili’s right post.

Industry observers note that the home side double their lead at The Kop end. Kerkez perhaps should shoot from the edge of the box but instead lays it back to Mac Allister. The Argentine then plays it to his left to find Gakpo, who cuts inside onto his right and fires into the far corner. This now his tenth goal in 13 League Cup appearances.

In a recent development, ruthless!! 🔥Cody Gakpo doubles Liverpool's lead against Spurs 🔴 pic.twitter.com/qlaaynMuwM.

No chances to speak of in the early stages of this second half.

It has been revealed that we are back under way at Anfield. Liverpool have made a change at the break with Jacquet coming on for Gomez. This was Gomez’s first game back after injury.

Possession: Liverpool 47%-53% TottenhamShots: 6-6Shots on target: 2-1Corners: 3-2Touches in opposition box: 10-8.

Tottenham did have two major chances through Bergvall and Kudus and there are arguments to say both of them should have scored.

Recent findings suggest that mac Allister takes but his effort is off target. That is indeed the final moment of the half and Liverpool take a 1-0 lead into the break courtesy of that fine Mac Allister strike.

We are past the two initial minutes added on but that is because of the delay when Senesi was given a talking-to moments ago. That allows Liverpool to win a free-kick not far outside the Tottenham box and Bentancur is booked for the foul on Gakpo.

This will be the final moment of the half.

It has been revealed that senesi absolutely clatters into McConnell but somehow escapes without a booking. There have been a number of soft yellows in this first yet one of the most blatant yellows is not given as a booking.

There will be two added minutes at the end of this first half.

Sources indicate that marmoush is the first Tottenham player booked tonight for a foul on McConnell and that feels on the harsh side. Definitely a foul but was it a yellow?

That is a dreadful decision from referee Andy Madley. Frimpong gets the better of Tel in a contest down Tottenham’s left, with the former outmuscling the latter. Not only is Frimpong penalised, he is booked.

Recent findings suggest that mac Allister spurns a glorious chance to get his and Liverpool’s second of the night. Tottenham again risk it at the back and lose it. McConnell then feeds a pass into the box to pick out the run of Koumas, who squares it for Mac Allister. The Argentine cannot get his feet sorted in time and wastes the opportunity from eight yards out.

Industry observers note that liverpool want a penalty. Tottenham give it away cheaply inside their own box and McConnell goes down under a challenge from Senesi, who was the one who gave it away. It was a clumsy challenge from Senesi and if VAR was in action tonight it would have been interesting to see what they would have done with that as Senesi did barge into the back of McConnell.

Araujo is then booked for pulling Marmoush back.

Recent findings suggest that there is no way Tottenham’s goal drought will last in perpetuity but they have missed two fabulous chances so far and you wonder what impact that will have on their confidence. At least one Tottenham player is being feted: Andy Robertson, who has just jogged down the touchline at Anfield in a different kit for the first time in nine years. He tried not to acknowledge the singing of his name too much but you could see it meant something to him.

The home fans serenade their former player Robertson as the now Tottenham left-back goes out to warm up.

Sources indicate that that is a massive chance for Kudus to equalise on the counter. Tottenham break from deep inside their own half and charge down their left. Bergvall waits for Udogie to come on the overlap before playing the pass. From the left side of the box, Udogie crosses for Kudus, who gets across the front of Kerkez. Kudus should probably score but lifts his effort over the bar from just six yards out.

According to recent reports, what a goal......that would of been! 🫢Kudus fires over what would of been a sensational move from Spurs#ITVFootball | @Carabao_Cup pic.twitter.com/a1TPzKyJlP.

In a recent development, gomez gives the ball away cheaply inside his own half before McConnell is penalised for a foul on Marmoush. Will Tottenham cross it or take the shot on from around 25 yards out? The answer is the latter and Marmoush goes for goal but misses the target.

That was a chance for Udogie. Senesi clips in a lovely ball over the top in behind to pick out the run from left-back of Udogie, who tries to chest it down but cannot keep it under control. Had he done so, it would have been a great chance.

The way Alexis Mac Allister has played this past fortnight, anyone would think he is trying to secure himself a new contract. All cynicism aside, that was a quite beautiful goal and attention must be drawn to Cody Gakpo’s involvement: he took a pass on his chest from Joe Gomez before opening up the pitch. We will say it again: the idea of selling Gakpo in the last window was madness.

He scored a stunner nearly a week ago against Atletico Madrid here in the Champions League and he adds another storming strike to his repertoire. The ball finds kindly to Mac Allister on the edge of the box after Udogie tackled Ngumoha and the Argentine finds the top corner with a first-time finish.

Sources indicate that pick that out!! 🇦🇷Alexis Mac Allister hits a beauty into the roof of the net 🔴 pic.twitter.com/G7OT27CA8P.

It has been revealed that koumas comes close to putting Liverpool in front with their first real chance of the game. Ngumoha slides a clinical pass into the box to pick out the run in behind of Koumas, who gets the better of Senesi. Koumas takes a great first touch before getting his shot away but is denied by Dubravka. Both goalkeepers have now been forced into good saves early doors.

Close for Lewis Koumas!The Liverpool youngster is denied by Martin Dubravka after some brilliant play by Rio Ngumoha 🪄 pic.twitter.com/YNC8QEAGGG.

Given their team has been bang average this season, the huge number of travelling Spurs fans are making a magnificent noise. They could have celebrated a long-overdue goal had it not been for a magnificent save by Giorgi Mamardashvili. The Georgian needed to make it from Lucas Bergvall, as a minute beforehand he dithered while Joe Gomez was shepherding a ball back to him and those on the Kop lost their minds. It’s tense amongst Liverpool supporters. You wonder how it changes.

In a recent development, that is a fantastic save from Mamardashvili. Gallagher plays the ball to Udogie on the left side of the box and the latter squares it to Bergvall in the centre of the box. Bergvall is no more than eight yards out and must think he is going to score but Mamardashvili makes a great save to deny the Swede. Should Bergvall have given Mamardashvili the chance to save it? Maybe not.

It has been revealed that significant save from Giorgi Mamardashvili! 💪Lucas Bergvall is denied by the Liverpool goalkeeper. pic.twitter.com/fKUbfGLMku.

Tottenham are dominating possession thus far, with a lot of the game being played in Liverpool’s half at the moment.

The heavens have well and truly opened at Anfield, with the rain heaving down.

Tottenham win a corner off Gomez out on the right. Kudus clips in an inswinger that Araujo heads away.

Gakpo is starting out on the left for Liverpool tonight, with Ngumoha on the right and Koumas leading the line down the centre. Gakpo was linked with a move to Tottenham and Manchester City over the summer but stayed at Liverpool.

Industry observers note that tottenham have a free-kick not far outside the Liverpool penalty area on the right as Kerkez is penalised for blocking Gallagher’s cross with his arm. Kudus’ delivery is headed away by Araujo.

Kudus keeps it alive and sends in another cross that ends up in Mamardashvili’s arms.

We are under way at Anfield, with a place in the fourth round at stake.

In a recent development, A reminder, there is no extra time so it the game is all square after 90 minutes we will go straight to penalties. Also, there is no VAR tonight.

Both sides emerge from the tunnel and we are moments away from kick-off at Anfield. In Virgil van Dijk’s absence, Joe Gomez captains Liverpool tonight. Here is a reminder of how the two sides line up this evening:.

Liverpool: Mamardashvili, Frimpong, Araujo, Gomez, Kerkez, Mac Allister, Nyoni, McConnell, Ngumoha, Koumas, Gakpo.Substitutes: Alisson, Endo, Jacquet, Szoboszlai, Isak, Munoz, Barcola, Gravenberch, Chambers.

Tottenham: Dubravka; Gray, Tosin, Senesi, Udogie; Bentancur, Bergvall; Kudus, Gallagher, Tel; Marmoush.Substitutes: Kinsky, Robertson, Van Hecke, Maddison, Savio, Fernandes, Solanke, Davies, Van de Ven.

"We have to be patient, I thought it was too much for him at Bournemouth at the start, but he got it right"Jamie Redknapp states Andoni Iraola "needs time" at Liverpool to implement his methods 💬 pic.twitter.com/hCVeZJ3qSn.

🗣️ "It's a lot of changes" Andoni Iraola explains why he's made 🔟 changes to the Liverpool starting 11 to face Spurs at Anfield 👀⁰#ITVFootball | @gabrielclarke05 | @Carabao_Cup pic.twitter.com/W3zy9aPbz2.

Let's get to work 💪 pic.twitter.com/ji1hsS4tyt.

Sources indicate that andrew Robertson played nearly 400 games for Liverpool and won countless trophies with the club, including two Premier League titles, two League Cups and the Champions League. Upon his return to Anfield, he starts on the bench against his former employers.

Djaksparo is a rising musician from Paris who who gained viral fame following a social media boost from Liverpool’s summer signing Bradley Barcola, who is on the bench for the hosts this evening.

Welcome to Anfield, Djaksparo 👋 pic.twitter.com/iueYa1KjL7.

"I would like to see the goals!"Roberto De Zerbi ahead of Spurs clash with Liverpool in the Carabao Cup 🙌 pic.twitter.com/uSjCJcnAfJ.

Richarlison is not happy at Roberto de Zerbi's decision to leave him out of Tottenham's squad tonight 🙅‍♂️ pic.twitter.com/WqRWb3KPed.

“There is no joy watching Spurs at the moment. Last year was a survival job, but now you have got to flip it. [Roberto] De Zerbi’s got a lot of players at his disposal.

“He has got to fit that jigsaw puzzle together. There are still a lot of elements that are not right; they have not got a left-sided player they can trust in. Goals have been a real problem, but I do think they will come.”.

Industry observers note that during the Spaniard’s three seasons at the helm at Bournemouth, he never made it past the fourth round in this competition. He reached the fourth round in his first season at Bournemouth during the 2023/24 season but in the last two seasons has fallen in the second round, which was the round Bournemouth entered the competition.

Just one player remains from Liverpool’s starting XI against Fulham on Saturday and that is Ronald Araujo. Virgil van Dijk and Florian Wirtz are given the night off for the home side.

Liverpool: Mamardashvili, Frimpong, Araujo, Gomez, Kerkez, Mac Allister, Nyoni, McConnell, Ngumoha, Koumas, Gakpo.Substitutes: Alisson, Endo, Jacquet, Szoboszlai, Isak, Munoz, Barcola, Gravenberch, Chambers.

Roberto De Zerbi makes eight changes from Tottenham’s draw against Everton, with Archie Gray, Rodrigo Bentancur and Omar Marmoush the three players to remain in the starting XI.

Tottenham: Dubravka; Gray, Tosin, Senesi, Udogie; Bentancur, Bergvall; Kudus, Gallagher, Tel; Marmoush.Substitutes: Kinsky, Robertson, Van Hecke, Maddison, Savio, Fernandes, Solanke, Davies, Van de Ven.

We're in the building 🏟️ pic.twitter.com/nPJefN5F3A.

Tottenham Hotspur did not pay Roberto De Zerbi, their head coach, a survival bonus for keeping the club in the Premier League and now Spurs are saving a fortune on goal bonuses.

De Zerbi’s team are yet to score against Premier League opposition this season and face Liverpool in the third round of the Carabao Cup at Anfield on Tuesday night.

It is understood that De Zerbi’s lucrative contract did not include a survival bonus for avoiding relegation last season, but he must wish his forwards were cashing in on their goal bonuses.

Peterborough vs Barnsley 7.30pmWest Ham vs Fulham 7.45pmIpswich vs Arsenal 8pmLiverpool vs Tottenham 8pmReading vs Brentford 8pm.

Our Spurs side to take on Liverpool 👊🔢 @krakenfx pic.twitter.com/X4f3F0cl4f.

Our team to take on Tottenham Hotspur 🔴 pic.twitter.com/tZSJkPpH3y.

A place in the League Cup fourth round is at stake at Anfield as Liverpool host Tottenham in an all-Premier League tie.

Liverpool were frustrated on the weekend, being held to a 0-0 draw at home against Fulham, meaning they have one win and three draws from their opening four league games.

Recent findings suggest that “I am very happy with the squad,” Liverpool head coach Andoni Iraola said. “I value a lot my players, if we win games, the squad will look amazing and fantastic, if we do not there is going to be a problem with the depth. I think we will see also tomorrow [tonight] players we have not seen still and I am really looking forward to seeing. I feel they are going to play well and help us and they still have not had their chance. You can decide and put the same players in every game. The problem is there will be a moment when they are really tired. And there is more risk of injury.

Recent findings suggest that “But that is why we cannot say it does not work for anyone. There are players who play every three days with no issues. They are very robust, their performances do not change too much. There are other players where the risk is bigger and the performances are different. I have to learn who is ready to play games every three days and who needs a rest so their performance level is not affected. I thought I had it quite clear in my mind with some, but with others, it is newly introduced, even for them, because they have not played as many games. We are learning.”.

Liverpool were knocked out in the fourth round of this competition last season, losing 3-0 at home against Crystal Palace. Joe Gomez returns to the squad for the hosts tonight after an injury early in pre-season but Giovanni Leoni, Hugo Ekitike, Conor Bradley and Federico Chiesa remain out.

Industry observers note that tottenham are still without a league win or goal this season. Their 0-0 draw at home against Everton Saturday means they sit just above the relegation zone. Tottenham overcame Charlton in the second round, convincingly winning 5-1 at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium last month.

Industry observers note that “I think we are working well,” Tottenham boss Roberto De Zerbi said. “We played 30 minutes, 25 minutes very well [against Everton]. In that moment we could score two goals. Then we lost maybe the confidence because we did not score. For sure we have to improve. For sure I have big confidence in my players, they are very good players.

Recent findings suggest that “We have to improve, yes. We can say the coach has responsibility if we do not score, yes, I accept, no problem. We did not win any game so far, yes. We are disappointed, sorry for that. But we have other positive things, like I said we did not [concede goals] in the last two games and the things we have to improve, we start our work. Nothing changed in my project and my idea.”.

Tottenham’s League Cup journey last season came to an end in the fourth round last season, losing 2-0 at Newcastle. Sandro Tonali and Pedro Porro will not be involved tonight for the visitors and neither will Richarlison, who has been left out. Andrew Robertson returns to Anfield for the first time after leaving Liverpool in the summer following nine years on Merseyside.

Team news from Anfield to follow shortly.

Rumilly rumine

📅 15 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 1 min read (240 words, 📖 Standard) | Source: Poteaux-carres

⏱️ ~1 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Partagés entre fierté et frustation, trois joueurs de Rumilly Vallières pointent l'arbitrage dans Le Dauphiné Libéré après la renversante victoire des Verts à Annecy.
  • Amine Saïd : "J’arrive à libérer l’équipe pour nous récompenser de nos efforts.
  • Nicolas Garby : "Quand on a marqué, on a senti que le stade n’était pas que vert et qu’on a fait plaisir à beaucoup de monde.

Partagés entre fierté et frustation, trois joueurs de Rumilly Vallières pointent l'arbitrage dans Le Dauphiné Libéré après la renversante victoire des Verts à Annecy.

Amine Saïd : "J’arrive à libérer l’équipe pour nous récompenser de nos efforts. C’est toujours particulier de jouer Saint-Etienne quand on vient de Lyon. Après, sur l’égalisation, on est à 10, on trinque pour une erreur d’arbitrage même si on doit être plus attentif. C’est d’autant plus frustrant. Sur le match, on a mis de l’intensité. J’ai essayé de leur faire mal après des appels dans le dos où j’ai réussi à me créer quelques situations.".

Nicolas Garby : "Quand on a marqué, on a senti que le stade n’était pas que vert et qu’on a fait plaisir à beaucoup de monde. Dans le contenu, on a rivalisé pour réaliser un bon match. On ouvre le score logiquement avant 5 minutes de battement et cette décision de l'arbitre de ne pas faire entrer Iroy Eckenfelder avant de reprendre un second but coup sur coup.".

Valentin Jakob : "On est frustré du déroulé, surtout sur les deux buts encaissés où l’arbitrage ne nous aide pas. Malgré ça, on a fait un beau match, surtout en seconde période où on doit les enfoncer sur nos grosses occasions qu’on ne transforme pas. Derrière, ils ont des demi-occasions et on se fait punir deux fois coup sur coup. Ca nous met un coup derrière la tête.".

A Coverciano, il commissario della Figc apre la 35ª Panchina d’Oro e richiama il ruolo delle società dilettantistiche.

Giovanni Malagò attribuisce agli allenatori un ruolo decisivo per il futuro del calcio italiano. Il commissario della Figc lo ha detto a Coverciano, a Firenze, aprendo la cerimonia della 35ª Panchina d’Oro. Sources indicate that le médiocre match que les Verts ont joué cet après-midi contre Rumilly Vallières finira vite aux oubliettes, sauf si les protégés de Ian Cathro ont la bonne idée de soulever la Coupe de France le 15 mai 2027 au Stade de France, 50 ans après le dernier sacre stéphanois dans cette compétion. On se souviendra alors que leur épopée aura démarré lors de ce piètre match à Annecy.

Industry observers note that L'entraîneur des Verts ne s'est pas trop étendu en Haute-Savoie après la laborieuse qualification de son équipe très remaniée. Il a surtout expliqué pourquoi son habituel capitaine et son meneur de jeu danois ont démarré cette rencontre sur le banc malgré les très nombreuses absences (10 internationaux présentement en sélection + 4 joueurs à l'infirmerie).

Industry observers note that "Notre travail et notre responsabilité étaient de passer au tour suivant. On l’a fait. Mais je suis très déçu de notre première période où nous ne sommes pas parvenus à montrer le niveau que nous voulons avoir, en manquant des choses simples. On a réussi à être plus connectés en seconde période après des changements, avec des erreurs malgré tout. On a produit des choses plus positives, ce qui a fait que nous avons aussi concédé plus de situations avec certains moments de flottement. Honnêtement, nous n’allons pas penser à ce match très longtemps. Julien Le Cardinal et Jakob Breum n'ont pas démarré la rencontre car ils ont beaucoup joué depuis le début de saison. L’objectif était de gérer leur charge. Jakob a notamment quelques gênes que nous devons prendre en compte. Dans un scénario idéal, ils seraient restés sur le banc. Mais on devait faire le nécessaire pour se qualifier et on s'est appuyés sur eux.".

The most famous name in Dutch football could appear on an international men’s team sheet for the first time in 30 years after Johan Cruyff’s grandson was called up for the United States’ upcoming matches in Europe.

Shae Cruijff-Beane, the son of Johan Cruyff’s daughter Chantal and her American husband Todd Beane, was included in the squad that will play against Norway and Portugal in the next seven days.

In a recent development, cruijff-Beane plays as a midfielder for Gimnàstic de Tarragona, a club in the Spanish third tier based near Barcelona. His older brother Jordan also came through the club’s ranks and is at the moment playing US college football at Westmont College in California.

Shae, 17, is eligible to play for the USA through his father and Spain and the Netherlands through his mother, who spent part of her childhood in Catalonia while Johan Cruyff was playing for Barcelona in the 1970s.

The USA under-18 squad also includes an Ajax player, midfielder Xander Newstead, who grew up in San Francisco and joined the Amsterdam club’s youth team set-up at the age of 10, beforec signing professional terms last year.

Johan Cruyff went on to play in the United States for Los Angeles Aztecs and Washington Diplomats before returning to the Netherlands, winding down his career at Ajax and Feyenoord.

His son Jordi played for Barcelona and Manchester United and won nine international caps in 1996. Last year he was appointed technical director at Ajax, the club where his father began his career.

In a recent development, although Noted El Mala signed a long-term contract extension with 1. FC Köln until 2031 over the summer, transfer speculation has continued to surround the 20-year-old.

There have even been suggestions that El Mala could leave the Billy Goats as early as the upcoming winter transfer window, but club president Jörg Stobbe considers that scenario highly unlikely.

Recent findings suggest that “I can't imagine him leaving in the winter at all. It would be absurd to let him go in January,” Stobbe underlined in an interview with Bild.

Stobbe is not only optimistic about El Mala staying beyond the winter transfer window, but hopes the young winger will remain at Köln for several more years.

In a recent development, “I would say it would be good if Stated played for us for at least another two years. Why not?” Stobbe asked rhetorically.

Industry News: EFL asks clubs to stop targeted 'banter' on social media amid fears over reputational damage in the wake of 'Spygate' fallout

📅 12 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 4 min read (749 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Dailymail

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Published: 09:54 EST, 12 November 2026 | Updated: 11:40 EST, 12 November 2026.
  • The EFL has written to clubs calling for a halt in reputationally damaging social media posts disguised as ‘banter’ - believing the line has been blurred when it comes to regulatory matters.
  • The letter expressed concern over a ‘growing pattern of posts that use disputes, disciplinary matters, alleged wrongdoing or rival Clubs as material for public “banter”.’.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By BOBBY MANZI, FOOTBALL REPORTER.

Published: 09:54 EST, 12 November 2026 | Updated: 11:40 EST, 12 November 2026.

The EFL has written to clubs calling for a halt in reputationally damaging social media posts disguised as ‘banter’ - believing the line has been blurred when it comes to regulatory matters.

The letter expressed concern over a ‘growing pattern of posts that use disputes, disciplinary matters, alleged wrongdoing or rival Clubs as material for public “banter”.’.

A letter, seen by Daily Mail Sport, has been sent by EFL chief executive Trevor Birch to club chairs and executives following a board meeting.

‘While any one post may be viewed as an isolated lapse, taken together they risk creating a culture in which short-term engagement is prioritised over judgement, responsibility and long-term reputation,’ the letter read.

‘This is not about removing humour, personality or rivalry from Club channels. It is about recognising when content becomes disparaging, prolongs a dispute, targets an individual, or calls the integrity of a Club or the competition into question.

‘The impact extends beyond the Clubs directly involved. Repeated public exchanges can inflame relationships, undermine confidence in the fairness and professionalism of our competitions, and weaken the collective EFL brand.

Industry observers note that the EFL have called for clubs to halt 'banter' social media posts. Pictured: Wrexham owners Rob Mac (left) and Ryan Reynolds (right) spoofed Southampton's Spygate case in September. Source: X/Wrexham_AFC.

Wrexham were among the clubs to mock the case by putting a not to 'check training ground for unauthorised visitors' prior to their match with Southampton on fixture release day. Source: X/Wrexham_AFC.

Birmingham City also referenced the case by revealing the date for their fixture by showing the club badges cut into hedges and visible through binoculars. Source: X/BCFC.

‘Recent media interest in perceived public disputes between Clubs illustrates how quickly individual posts can become a wider reputational problem.’.

Daily Mail Sport understands the EFL are keen to avoid being seen as killjoys. Rather, they are taking a preventative approach to posts that could end up breaching FA or EFL rules.

The Southampton ‘Spygate’ scandal is among the most prominent disputes that have been referenced by clubs in social media content in recent months.

Both Birmingham City and Wrexham shared posts on the Championship fixture release date in June, using the case to highlight the dates of a fixture with Southampton.

Recent findings suggest that birmingham’s official X account posted a graphic of both clubs' badges cut into hedges which were viewed through binoculars. The account added: ‘One of the other key fixtures to keep an eye on...’.

It has been revealed that wrexham’s calendar for their matches in September included a reminder to 'check training ground for unauthorised visitors’ two days before they played Southampton. An image of a man behind a tree was included in the Southampton badge.

It has been revealed that the club also included their Hollywood owners Ryan Reynolds and Rob Mac in a spoof video in the build-up to the match. The actors were seen behind a tree similar to one which Southampton intern William Salt was caught spying near ahead of their play-off semi-final with Middlesbrough.

Following the revelations by Daily Mail Sport, Southampton were eventually thrown out of the play-offs.

Last week, Blackburn hit back at a video of West Ham manager Scott Parker declaring he ‘didn’t see a Blackburn fan’ by showing images of their supporters celebrating goals in their 2-1 win over the Hammers.

In a recent development, blackburn hit back at West Ham boss Scott Parker last week after he declared he ‘didn’t see a Blackburn fan', with the club then showing supporters celebrating goals. Source: X/Rovers.

Sources indicate that the EFL reminded clubs in their letter that regulations called for clubs to ‘to act towards one another with utmost good faith’. The organisation called for clubs to consider whether their content is ‘punching down’ or ‘targeting a specific Club or individual’, adding they would likely cross the threshold if it does.

The organisation stressed that its preference is for ‘engagement and prevention’ and was not requesting clubs to make ‘bland or risk-free’ content.

However, the EFL warned it is prepared to take ‘proportionate and consistent action’ where ‘conduct which doesn’t meet the standards we expect is repeated or serious.’.

Clubs have been asked to ensure a senior leader owns the standard applied to the club’s content, as well as formalising approval arrangements, briefing relevant people and exercising restraint.

After a humiliating defeat by Grimsby Town in their previous League Cup campaign, Manchester United found a different way to exit the competition this time around. The jeers heard at the full-time whistle after throwing away a two-goal lead pointed to more worrying times a year on from Blundell Park.

For the first time in half a century, United lost a game at Old Trafford having led 2-0, highlighting the defensive problems Michael Carrick needs to solve after turning results around last season.

“What the f---ing hell was that?” shouted the home fans, in a chant that may have been aimed at the referee but equally applied to United’s players, who led through Shea Lacey and Mason Mount’s early goals.

  • "En seconde période, on est rentré sur le terrain avec beaucoup d’ambitions.

Pas exempt de tout reproche sur le but qui a éliminé son équipe hier à Annecy, le gardien du GFA Rumilly Vallières Valentin Baume revient sur la victoire des Verts dans la dernière édition du Dauphiné Libéré. Extraits.

"En seconde période, on est rentré sur le terrain avec beaucoup d’ambitions. On voulait s’installer chez eux et aller les chercher pour produire notre jeu. Cela a payé car on parvient à ouvrir le score. Malheureusement, on prend ces deux buts derrière et on perd le match alors qu’on aurait vraiment pu réaliser un exploit.

Sources indicate that les Verts égalisent à 11 contre 10, je n’ai pas trop compris ce qu’il s’est passé au moment du changement. Au final, ils ont une situation où je me jette pour réaliser l’arrêt miracle [devant Thierno Ballo, ndp2]. Je parviens à toucher le ballon, malheureusement, il revient sur un autre joueur de Saint-Etienne [Ben Old, ndp2] qui marque.

Sur le deuxième but, il centre fort. J’essaye de sortir pour éloigner le ballon le plus loin possible. Malheureusement, je suis un peu court, je ne le repousse pas assez fort et il retombe sur la tête de leur joueur [Joao Ferreira, ndp2] qui marque. Je suis un peu malchanceux et malheureux sur cette situation.".

Two and a half years after joining RB Leipzig from Croatian outfit NK Kustošija for a reported €3 million fee, 19-year-old Dino Klapija looks set to move on.

According to Sky Germany, both parties are open to parting ways, with a move back to the United States potentially on the cards for the young striker, who has yet to make an appearance for RB Leipzig's first team.

Klapija has represented the United States at U18, U19 and U20 level. He has scored four goals in 10 appearances for the U20 side.

According to Transfermarkt, he has found the net 16 times in 69 appearances for RB Leipzig's U19 team.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By CHRIS WHEELER, NORTHERN SPORTS WRITER.

Published: 03:10 EST, 11 November 2026 | Updated: 12:15 EST, 12 November 2026.

Manchester United are set to name Mauricio Pochettino as head coach to replace Michael Carrick following a day of talks over both men.

United moved closer to putting Pochettino in charge at Old Trafford after reaching a verbal agreement with the US national team boss on Wednesday. The club then made a formal approach to US Soccer.

Meanwhile, the club’s chief executive Omar Berrada and director of football Jason Wilcox flew back from Monaco, where minority owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe was expected to ratify their decision to sack Carrick with the blessing of co-chairmen Joel and Avram Glazer.

Carrick’s departure could be confirmed on Thursday, but official confirmation of Pochettino’s appointment may take a little longer with more talks planned overnight on Wednesday.

Pochettino is currently at the US Soccer base outside Atlanta preparing for a CONCACAF Nations League quarter-final double header against Haiti, and is due to speak to the media on Friday.

In a recent development, it’s unclear if he will remain in charge for those games, with United said to be relaxed over the Argentine taking the team. It is possible he could stay for the first leg in Kingston, Jamaica at the weekend and then travel to Manchester.

Manchester United are set to name Mauricio Pochettino as their latest manager - but he took training as usual on Wednesday.

Pochettino, who has managed Southampton,Tottenham, and Chelsea, will succeed Michael Carrick.

Carrick checked in at Carrington at 7.45am on Wednesday with his fate in the balance.

He was pictured leaving Manchester United's training base at around 1.15pm.

Pochettino is pictured working on United States national team duty on Tuesday (Source: X/USMNT).

The second leg is Cincinnati is not until the early hours of Thursday, and Pochettino may even would only take over at United on Friday with a huge game against Liverpool at Anfield 48 hours later.

It’s understood that the US Soccer Federation are ready for this contingency and have a succession plan in place should he leave.

It will cost Pochettino around £7million to buy himself out of his contract with the US Soccer Federation, with United ready to foot the bill.

The cost of bringing in his back-room team, including trusted assistants Jesus Perez and Miguel D’Agostino, will take the cost above £10m.

The 54-year-old only signed a upcoming deal after the World Cup meaning that United could have got him for nothing in the summer.

Amid the secret talks between United and Pochettino’s camp on Wednesday, there was more intrigue when the federation cancelled media access to the players at late notice but allowed cameras to film an open training session.

Sources said the decision was made out of respect for Veterans Day in America, but it also meant the players didn’t have to field any awkward questions over their coach’s future.

Bournemouth midfielder Tyler Adams was quoted by the US media as saying: ‘Why would his name not be on it (United’s list)?

Sir Jim Ratcliffe, Omar Berrada and Jason Wilcox are meeting in Monaco for talks today.

The United execs meet in Monaco today (Pictured is the Casino Monte-Carlo in Monaco).

‘I mean, the credibility, the resume speaks for itself. It goes to show for us how lucky we are to be able to work under a manager of his quality and the person he is.’.

Meanwhile, Berrada and Wilcox flew back to Manchester from Nice on Wednesday with United expected to announce Carrick’s departure imminently after 10 months in charge.

The 45-year-old took training at Carrington for the second day running, arriving at 7.45am and leaving shortly after 1.30pm.

However, it has been clear for some days that Carrick would lose his job after United dropped into the relegation zone following the club’s worst start in 40 years.

#2866. Breaking: Les Vertes sont mieux que des Nice Girls

📅 16 Nov 2026 • ⏱️ 2m • 📖 Standard (470 w)
📖 Baca
General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Poteaux-carres ↗ Open Full Page

Breaking: Les Vertes sont mieux que des Nice Girls

📅 16 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 2 min read (470 words, 📖 Standard) | Source: Poteaux-carres

⏱️ ~2 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Les Amazones poursuivent leur sans-faute en Arkema Seconde Ligue !Ce samedi, les protégées de Yannick Chandioux ont décroché leur sixième succès consécutif en dominant l'OGC Nice (1-0) au stade Salif-Keïta.
  • Yannick Chandioux: "Je suis satisfait de cette victoire, notamment de notre première période, durant laquelle nous nous sommes procuré beaucoup d’occasions (...) En revanche, il n’est pas normal de ne pas avoir réussi à creuser l’écart avec une vingtaine d’occasions et plus d’une dizaine de corners.
  • En effet, avec désormais 20 points au compteur, six victoires consécutives et toujours aucune défaite après huit journées, les Vertes confirment leur place de leader, uniquement talonnées par Le Mans et Roubaix, formations toutes deux victorieuses le lendemain.

Les Amazones poursuivent leur sans-faute en Arkema Seconde Ligue !Ce samedi, les protégées de Yannick Chandioux ont décroché leur sixième succès consécutif en dominant l'OGC Nice (1-0) au stade Salif-Keïta. Avant cette rencontre, les Stéphanoises occupaient la première place du classement avec 17 points, devant Le Mans et Roubaix, tandis que les Azuréennes pointaient au dixième rang seulement.Pour conserver son fauteuil de leader, le coach ligérien avait reconduit Ithaisa Viñoly dans les cages, derrière une défense Couasnon-Kack-Blanchard-Sierra. Faustine Bataillard et Héloïse Mansuy étaient chargées de l'entrejeu, tandis que la capitaine Sarah Cambot accompagnait Jana Zufankova, Tyler Isgrig et Dona Scannapieco dans le secteur offensif.Et les Vertes ne tardaient pas à prendre les choses en main malgré une première (et la seule) intervention d'Ithaisa Viñoly. D'abord une première tentative de Jana Zufankova dès la 2e minute puis une ouverture du score logique au quart d'heure de jeu: sur un centre parfaitement ajusté de Sarah Cambot, Tyler Isgrig surgissait au second poteau pour placer une tête victorieuse et inscrire son 5e pion de la saison, le 4e enc championnat (1-0, 15e).Les Amazones manquaient même le break dans la foulée lorsque la tentative de Mansuy était sauvée sur la ligne (20e) puis celle de Cambot repoussée par la gardienne niçoise (38e).Avec leur petit avantage; les Vertes continuaient de monopoliser le ballon en deuxième période sans parvenir à tuer le suspense. Ninon Blanchard trouvait notamment la transversale sur corner (65e) puis Dona Scannapieco butait à son tour sur l'excellente portière azuréenne (75e). Malgré quelques timides velléités niçoises en fin de rencontre, la défense stéphanoise tenait bon pour préserver ce court mais précieux avantage.

Yannick Chandioux: "Je suis satisfait de cette victoire, notamment de notre première période, durant laquelle nous nous sommes procuré beaucoup d’occasions (...) En revanche, il n’est pas normal de ne pas avoir réussi à creuser l’écart avec une vingtaine d’occasions et plus d’une dizaine de corners. Nous avons encore du travail à faire dans ce domaine. Il faut forcément souligner cette série de six victoires consécutives en championnat. Nous avons également signé un nouveau clean-sheet, tout en nous montrant dangereux offensivement. Cette série doit surtout nous rappeler que nous devons rester pleinement concernés. J’essaie d’impliquer l’ensemble de mon groupe dans cette dynamique: chacune a eu et aura sa chance".

En effet, avec désormais 20 points au compteur, six victoires consécutives et toujours aucune défaite après huit journées, les Vertes confirment leur place de leader, uniquement talonnées par Le Mans et Roubaix, formations toutes deux victorieuses le lendemain. De quoi aborder la suite avec confiance, à commencer par un déplacement à Guéret, pensionnaire de Régional 2, dimanche prochain pour leur entrée en lice en Coupe de France. L'occasion pour les Stéphanoises de poursuivre leur belle dynamique et, pourquoi pas, de s'offrir un joli parcours dans la compétition !
